aluminum_quenching_2.name: Quenching of Aluminum - Level 2
aluminum_quenching_2.description: Simulate the quenching process of Aluminum by cooling its molten structure under NPT conditions using the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential. Detect the glass transition temperature (Tg), defined as the temperature at which the slope of density versus temperature changes. Report the Tg value in Kelvin.
